title: Electric shaver
prompt: a rotary electric shaver with a patch of model stubble on a table with three buttons: “Start” spins the cutters; “Shave” brings hairs through the screens and cuts them; “Lift head” opens the cutter assembly; see-through reveals the perforated screens, rotating blades and sprung drive shafts
blurb: A teaching adaptation of a rotary shaver shows how sprung cutters shear model hairs beneath slotted guards.
teachingAdaptations: Enlarged hairs, slots, gears and springs make contact visible.
The specimen is moved and inverted by a teaching control, representing an external hand, then returned to the table.
The gears turn slowly for inspection; this is not a specified real motor speed.
A simplified central spur gear drives three output gears; the model is representative rather than a reproduction of one commercial shaver.
Opening the head stops the demonstration motor; no hardware interlock is claimed.
The finite specimen is not replenished. Refreshing the page resets the teaching scene.

mechanismSources.supports: Three driven spur gears, partition plate, hair-blocking seals and spring-loaded cutter drive shafts.
Hinged shaving unit, hair chamber, retaining frame and matched cutter/guard pairs.
